events.title: Demo Update #4. Getting Ready for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello everyone! We will be participating in Steam Next Fest on October 19! If you enjoyed our project, we would be grateful for any support before and during the festival.Add the game to your wishlist, play the updated demo, and leave feedback in our Discord channel! Thank you!Changelog:Added in-game music playerFixed the cost of orders during the "Total Defense" stageReduced the cost of building the tower's second floorAdded the ability to toggle the tutorial on/off in the game settings

events.title: Demo Update #2!
events.summary: This update fixes the following bugs:Fixed issues in the science menu on 2K resolution monitorsAdded auto-save every minute to the first save slot in the save menuFixed issues with game time stopping in the game menu and science menuFixed incorrect time counting in the demo end screenChanged color and added animation to the tutorial pointer arrowRemoved strict tutorial step validation that would cut the tutorial shortThank you for your attention! Enjoy the game!

events.title: Day 1 Demo Update!
events.summary: Fixed a bug where time would stop at the start of the game, preventing robot production.The construction panel no longer overlaps with other UI elements.The research menu pauses the game while open. Thanks for your feedback! Jump back into the game and save humanity!
